title: Chio Capability Presentation
description: `chio.capability-presentation.v1` (PROTOCOL 5.6.5), carried in MCP `_meta.chioCapability`. The envelope is unsigned; every member inside is verified independently.

ancestors.description: Signed ancestors ordered root to parent. A root presented alone has an empty list.

delegation_context.description: Required when the presenter is not the session holder, so the verifier can recompute `context_digest`.
